deficiency_class: local evidence slot is empty or not tied to a real site/jurisdiction
must_open_when: any sparse emergency gate row lacks artifact date, owner, verifier or counterevidence path
required_closure_artifacts: populate local evidence row with artifact hash/reference, owner, verifier, freshness date and public-safe disclosure status
minimum_closeout_test: independent reviewer confirms row cannot be green via template text alone

deficiency_class: EPZ demographic/route/institution data are older than SLA or major local change
must_open_when: census, school, hospital, LTC, transit, route, wildfire/flood/heat, or major employer change not reflected
required_closure_artifacts: refresh EPZ assumptions; rerun affected ETE/protective-action branch; record deltas
minimum_closeout_test: exercise or tabletop uses refreshed population/access assumptions

deficiency_class: alert channel test misses vulnerable group or geographic segment
must_open_when: siren, EAS, WEA, route alert, IPAWS, language, disability or backup power test fails
required_closure_artifacts: repair channel, retest with affected group, publish public-safe result and residual limits
minimum_closeout_test: same-channel retest plus alternate-channel proof

deficiency_class: evacuation route capacity, control point, fuel, reception or shadow-evacuation assumption fails
must_open_when: ETE not current or drill shows bottleneck under weather/traffic/school-day conditions
required_closure_artifacts: rerun ETE branch, update traffic control, transport assistance and reception plan
minimum_closeout_test: functional drill/tabletop shows branch decision and bottleneck mitigation

deficiency_class: transportation-assistance registry misses carless, disability, medical or dialysis/oxygen needs
must_open_when: registry stale, unconsented, inaccessible or not connected to pickup dispatch
required_closure_artifacts: refresh registry, verify consent/privacy, run pickup dispatch test
minimum_closeout_test: dispatch test reconciles requests, vehicles, aides, destination and return/relocation needs

deficiency_class: school, childcare, hospital or long-term-care protective action path is unexercised
must_open_when: institution relies on generic evacuation/shelter guidance without bus/medical/family reunification proof
required_closure_artifacts: execute institution-specific branch drill; document reunification, medication, records and staffing
minimum_closeout_test: drill evidence covers off-hours, no-car families, medically fragile people and language access

deficiency_class: KI is used as a substitute for evacuation, sheltering, monitoring or ingestion controls
must_open_when: scorecard, public message or political claim implies KI is broad radiation protection
required_closure_artifacts: revise messages and scorecard logic; require companion controls for evacuation/shelter/decon/food-water
minimum_closeout_test: public message and gate logic explicitly state KI limits and companion controls

deficiency_class: KI inventory exists but distribution, dosing, contraindication or access path is unverified
must_open_when: stockpile lacks rotation date, trigger authority, distribution path, dosing instructions or equity check
required_closure_artifacts: inventory reconciliation, distribution drill, contraindication/translation review and trigger decision log
minimum_closeout_test: drill proves who authorizes, who receives, how instructions are understood and what KI does not cover

deficiency_class: community reception center registration/screening/decon throughput is not sized
must_open_when: CRC plan lacks expected arrival curve, staffing, instruments, privacy/data and family-reunification workflow
required_closure_artifacts: size CRC flow, run throughput tabletop or drill, validate data/privacy and decon waste path
minimum_closeout_test: CRC exercise demonstrates registration, screening, decon referral, reunification and data protection

deficiency_class: hospital or EMS pathway cannot separate trauma, contamination, internal exposure and worried-well demand
must_open_when: hospital plan lacks contamination control, referral, surge, staff protection or patient transfer proof
required_closure_artifacts: run hospital/EMS inject, update triage and contamination-control plan
minimum_closeout_test: exercise shows contaminated/injured patients managed without shutting down emergency care

deficiency_class: food, milk, agriculture, livestock, fish/game or water controls cannot beat product movement
must_open_when: sampling chain, lab prioritization, embargo authority, alternate water or compensation is unclear
required_closure_artifacts: pre-map products/water intakes/labs, run sample-to-advisory clock, preauthorize producer supports
minimum_closeout_test: exercise demonstrates sample collection, chain-of-custody, lab decision, advisory and compensation path

deficiency_class: alternate drinking-water plan is not executable for affected systems and institutions
must_open_when: water intakes, treatment plants, bottled/bulk water logistics or public advisories are not mapped
required_closure_artifacts: map intakes and alternate supply, run water advisory logistics tabletop
minimum_closeout_test: tabletop proves supply priority for hospitals, LTC, schools, shelters and no-car households

deficiency_class: emergency worker dose/PPE/dosimetry/turnback controls are not operational
must_open_when: worker exposure controls exist as policy but no issue/return logs, turnback criteria or fatigue controls
required_closure_artifacts: run responder radiation-safety drill and reconcile dosimetry/PPE records
minimum_closeout_test: drill confirms briefing, dose tracking, PPE, decon, refusal rights and after-action correction

deficiency_class: dose assessment or field monitoring cannot support protective-action decisions
must_open_when: monitoring network, dose projection, lab QA, chain-of-custody or dashboard evidence is stale/missing
required_closure_artifacts: field monitoring drill with projected/actual dose reconciliation and public-safe publication check
minimum_closeout_test: drill records time from data to recommendation and counterevidence disposition

deficiency_class: after-action report exists but findings are not assigned, retested or closed
must_open_when: exercise finding remains open without owner, deadline, retest or compensating control
required_closure_artifacts: create corrective-action record; close only after evidence and retest when material
minimum_closeout_test: independent evaluator confirms closeout evidence resolves original failure mode

deficiency_class: emergency-plan change may reduce effectiveness without adequate review/disclosure path
must_open_when: plan change removes/reduces emergency planning function or resource and review is missing
required_closure_artifacts: perform 50.54(q)-style review, document reduction/no-reduction basis, route approval
minimum_closeout_test: review record ties change to emergency planning functions and retained/replaced capability

deficiency_class: SMR/non-LWR/NPUF branch lacks performance objectives, metrics or drills
must_open_when: performance-based EP claim lacks quarterly metrics, drill evidence or response function demonstration
required_closure_artifacts: record performance objectives/metrics and drill/exercise evidence for response functions
minimum_closeout_test: metrics and exercises show classification, mitigation, protective actions, communications, command/control and staffing

deficiency_class: mutual-aid resource typing, access or reimbursement fails under regional contention
must_open_when: same resources are promised to multiple sites/disasters or reimbursement/legal path is unclear
required_closure_artifacts: resource typing, mission request, staging, reimbursement and backfill tabletop
minimum_closeout_test: tabletop proves who requests, releases, moves, pays and backfills resources

deficiency_class: public information is not plain, timely, translated, accessible or rumor-aware
must_open_when: JIC messages fail language/disability/social-media/rumor-control tests
required_closure_artifacts: rewrite templates, test message timing and comprehension, establish rumor correction log
minimum_closeout_test: public test captures message issue time, translations, accessible formats and corrections

deficiency_class: public counterevidence/anomaly reports are ignored or buried
must_open_when: monitoring anomaly, community report or contrary measurement lacks intake and disposition path
required_closure_artifacts: open counterevidence ledger with triage, lab review, response and appeal status
minimum_closeout_test: sample anomalies have documented disposition and public-safe explanation

deficiency_class: reentry/return decisions lack dose, monitoring, cleanup, worker-safety or public challenge criteria
must_open_when: people are allowed back or kept out without decision criteria and appeal/support path
required_closure_artifacts: create reentry/return decision record, monitoring basis, support path and counterevidence route
minimum_closeout_test: decision log shows criteria, affected-public notice, support, appeal and residual restrictions

deficiency_class: relocation, claims, benefits continuity and legal aid are not ready
must_open_when: households face displacement costs, lost wages, damaged property or access barriers without path
required_closure_artifacts: stand up claims/benefits/legal-aid intake with documentation alternatives and appeal route
minimum_closeout_test: tabletop demonstrates no-wrong-door intake and special-case escalation

deficiency_class: emergency plan only works in single-hazard, normal-grid, normal-road conditions
must_open_when: heat, smoke, flood, winter storm, outage, cyber/misinformation or resource contention invalidates plan
required_closure_artifacts: run compound-disaster inject and update degraded-mode branches
minimum_closeout_test: exercise shows branch decisions, alternate communications, staffing, transport and shelter tradeoffs

deficiency_class: official source changed after cube template was written
must_open_when: NRC/FEMA/CDC/EPA source date/version changes or URL moves without audit update
required_closure_artifacts: refresh source-freshness audit, update source register and affected crosswalk rows
minimum_closeout_test: diff record shows no broken assumptions or lists required content changes
